description: Input contract for one audit run (PROJECT_BOOK §6.1). A profile names the engine, the working directory and home directory, the source roots to enumerate, and the policy to compare against. Paths are fixture-relative in tests; real paths come from the user's local profile file and are never written into golden files. `forbidden_scopes` is the T006 extension of the book example (PolicyV1.forbiddenScopes): a deny-list to go with `allowed_scopes`.

bot_id.description: FIX-R1 (P1-R1-01): the OpenMausBot bot id whose opt-out state is audited (the <bot-id> in skill-state/<bot-id>/library-opt-out.json). REQUIRED for engine openmausbot - the CLI rejects a profile without it (exit 3). profile_id is the audit profile id, not a bot id, and is never silently used as one.

config_path.description: FIX-R1 (P1-R1-04): explicit path of the Codex user config (skills.config selectors, [skills.bundled]) for engine codex. Resolved relative to the profile file's directory when relative. Overrides the default search (profile-dir config.toml, then <home_root>/.codex/config.toml). A named file that does not exist is an input error (exit 3).

cwd.description: Working directory of the audited session (fixture-relative in tests).

data_dir.description: FIX-R1 (P1-R1-01): explicit OpenMausBot data directory holding config.json and skill-state/ for engine openmausbot. Resolved relative to the profile file's directory when relative. Overrides OMB_DATA_DIR and the <home_root>/.openmausbot default. The resolved directory and its source are reported by the adapter.

home_root.description: Home directory of the audited user (fixture-relative in tests).

policy.description: What the user expects the bot to be able to load (T006 PolicyV1, snake_case file form).

allowed_scopes.description: Allow-list: an ELIGIBLE instance outside this list leaks.

forbidden_names.description: Exact logical names (namespace included) the user expects disabled.

forbidden_scopes.description: Deny-list: an ELIGIBLE instance in a listed scope leaks.

profile_id.description: Stable id of this audit profile, e.g. "codex-billing-repo".

repo_root.description: Repository root of the audited session (fixture-relative in tests).

schema.description: Contract version. Any other value is an unknown profile version.

snapshot_path.description: FIX-R1 (P1-R1-01): explicit path of the versioned OpenMausBot per-bot snapshot JSON for engine openmausbot. Resolved relative to the profile file's directory when relative. Overrides the default ./snapshot.json lookup. A missing snapshot is INCOMPLETE (ADR-007), never silently empty.

source_roots.description: Source roots to enumerate, in audit order.

title: SkillScope audit profile (v1)
